title: Launch WebOps Factory
audience: Small web teams and agency owners who need a reviewable way to repair static websites.
objective: Create a benefits-first launch campaign for WebOps Factory. Show small web teams how a visible factory floor turns supported static-site findings into focused repairs and a reviewable candidate. Invite readers to open the repository README for complete setup instructions. This campaign introduces the product; it is not an installation tutorial.
voice: Plain, confident English. Concrete benefits, no hype, no invented personal biography.
constraints: Attribute repository-described behavior clearly. Treat recorded timings as observations, never promises.
State that supported static-site checks are bounded; human review and deployment remain separate.
Do not reproduce command sequences or partial setup instructions in any format. Link to the repository README for full prerequisites and setup.

Lead with the practical benefit: a visible path from a finding to a checked repair, with evidence available to reviewers. Use plain language and avoid repetitive qualifications; keep claim-specific limits close to their claims.
